title: Avoiding the Pitfalls of Revival Culture
description: In this powerful sermon, Pastor Chris Zehner tackles the sensitive topic of revival culture and its potential pitfalls, urging listeners to prioritize a balanced and normal Christian walk over a superficial experience. He shares candid and humorous anecdotes to illustrate the importance of avoiding flaky, feel-good Christianity and instead striving for a strong, word-based faith. Don't miss this timely and practical teaching that will challenge you to take your faith to the next level.
